SSH is a way to connect to a remote server through an encrypted channel. A DBA's day almost always starts with an SSH login. The question asked on the first connection is the step that checks "is this server really the server I think it is".

설치 가이드는 커널의 최소 버전도 정해 둡니다. Red Hat 호환 커널: The installation guide also sets a minimum kernel version. For the Red Hat Compatible Kernel (RHCK) it is 4.18.0-80.el8.x86_64 or later. The installation guide says to confirm with ping before installation that the host name resolves through DNS or /etc/hosts. If the name does not resolve, the installer and the listener do not work properly. Without a count, ping keeps sending until you press Ctrl+C, so add -c.

DB를 새로 올릴 서버 dbserver02를 받았어요. 시스템 관리자가: We got dbserver02, a server for a new DB. The system administrator handed over a window logged in as root. <code>Oracle Linux Server 8.10</code>입니다: It is Oracle Linux Server 8.10. Oracle Linux 8 is on the installation guide's list of supported OSes. It is the same OS as the stage 1 server, but this time it is a new server where nothing from Oracle is installed yet.

The same checklist says that when using HugePages, subtract the memory given to HugePages from RAM before calculating (recalculated in lesson 5, HugePages).

Writing the guideline and the actual value side by side, as in "swap 16GB (RAM 31.1GB, guideline 16GB) OK", makes it easy for others to check again.
preinstall RPM으로 설치 준비 한 번에 하기: Preparing for installation in one go with the preinstall RPM
오라클에 필요한 패키지와 OS 설정을 손으로 하나씩 할 수도 있지만, O: You could set up the packages and OS settings Oracle needs one by one by hand, but Oracle Linux has the oracle-database-preinstall-19c package that does it all at once. Compare before and after installing it.
오라클에 필요한 패키지 몇 개가 설치되어 있는지 확인하기: Check whether a few packages Oracle needs are installed
<code>package ksh is not installed</code: You see missing packages, as in package ksh is not installed. The installation guide lists the packages needed on Oracle Linux 8 in a table (31 of them, including bc, binutils, compat-openssl10, ksh, libaio, libaio-devel, and sysstat), and notes that a Linux installed as minimal lacks many of the required RPMs.
oracle 사용자가 아직 없는지 확인하기: Check that the oracle user does not exist yet
<code>no such user</code>가 나옵니다. 새 서버에는: It says no such user. The new server does not yet have the Oracle software owner account.
dnf install oracle-database-preinstall-1:
dnf install oracle-database-preinstall-19c
(type y at Is this ok [y/N]:)
dnf가 preinstall RPM과 함께 빠져 있던 의존 패키지(ksh: dnf installed the preinstall RPM together with the missing dependent packages (ksh, libaio-devel, sysstat, and others). According to the installation guide, this RPM installs the required packages, creates the oracle user and the oinstall and dba groups, and sets kernel parameters and resource limits. The values in this lab were checked by extracting the oracle-database-preinstall-19c-1.0-4.el8 package from the official Oracle Linux 8 repository and reading the configuration file (.param) and scripts inside it.
아까 빠져 있던 패키지가 설치됐는지 다시 확인하기: Check again whether the packages that were missing are now installed
Now they all appear with versions, like ksh-20120801-272.0.1.el8_10.x86_64. Whenever you install something, always check again.
설치 가이드 목록에는 있지만 RPM이 함께 깔지 않는 패키지 확인하기: Check packages that are on the installation guide's list but that the RPM does not install
<code>is not installed</code>가 나옵니다. 설치: It says is not installed. The installation guide's Oracle Linux 8 package table includes compat-openssl10 and elfutils-libelf-devel, but the dependency list (Requires) of preinstall RPM 1.0-4.el8 does not include them. So depending on the server's state, they may be missing as on this lab server. This is why you check once more against the installation guide's package table even after using the preinstall RPM.
<code>-y</code>는 \"Is this ok?\" 질문에 미리: -y answers yes in advance to the "Is this ok?" question. On a production server it is safer to see what will be installed before answering, so make it a habit to run it without -y the first time.
preinstall RPM이 만든 oracle 사용자 확인하기: Check the oracle user created by the preinstall RPM
<code>uid=54321(oracle) gid=54321(oinsta: You see uid=54321(oracle) gid=54321(oinstall) and the groups dba (54322), oper (54323), backupdba (54324), dgdba (54325), kmdba (54326), and racdba (54330). These are exactly the numbers written in the configuration file inside the RPM. That is why it matches the id output on the stage 1 server. This RPM does not create the ASM groups or the grid user, so you create them yourself in lesson 7 (groups and users).
preinstall RPM이 남긴 작업 기록 읽기: Read the work log left by the preinstall RPM
RPM 안의 스크립트는 바꾼 내용을 이 파일에 남깁니다. 커널 파라미터를: The scripts inside the RPM record what they changed in this file. It shows that kernel parameters were added, a copy was saved in /etc/sysctl.d/99-oracle-database-preinstall-19c-sysctl.conf, the resource limits file was written, and THP and the boot options (numa=off, transparent_hugepage=never) were changed. The original files before the change remain in /var/log/oracle-database-preinstall-19c/backup and /etc/sysctl.d/99-initial-sysctl.conf. Not moving on without knowing what changed is a DBA habit.
preinstall RPM은 편하지만 만능은 아닙니다. 설치 가이드(Gr: The preinstall RPM is convenient but not almighty. The installation guide (Grid Infrastructure side) notes that this RPM's kernel and resource settings apply only to the oracle account, so other installation owners such as grid must be set up by hand. If you know what the RPM changes, you can use the same criteria later when checking a server prepared by hand (stage 2 graduation mission).
preinstall RPM이 커널 파라미터를 바꿔 놓았어요. 어느 파일에: The preinstall RPM changed the kernel parameters. Check for yourself which file has what, whether it is actually applied to the current kernel, and whether it exceeds the installation guide's minimums.
커널 파라미터 설정 파일이 있는 디렉터리 보기: View the directory holding the kernel parameter configuration files
<code>99-oracle-database-preinstall-19c-: There are 99-oracle-database-preinstall-19c-sysctl.conf (the file the RPM created), 99-initial-sysctl.conf (the original before the change), and 99-sysctl.conf -> ../sysctl.conf (a link). The installation guide says to use a file such as /etc/sysctl.d/97-oracle-database-sysctl.conf when setting values by hand, and describes /etc/sysctl.conf as deprecated (a method that will no longer be used). The script of preinstall RPM 1.0-4.el8 writes the values to /etc/sysctl.conf too and puts a copy in sysctl.d.
preinstall RPM이 넣은 값 읽기: Read the values the preinstall RPM put in
설치 가이드의 최소값 표와 비교해 보세요. 세마포어 <code>kerne: Compare them with the installation guide's table of minimum values. For the semaphores, kernel.sem must list all four values, semmsl 250, semmns 32000, semopm 100, and semmni 128, in this order. fs.file-max minimum 6815744, fs.aio-max-nr 1048576, kernel.shmmni 4096, net.core.rmem_max 4194304, net.core.wmem_max 1048576. Every value in the file is at or above the minimum.
지금 커널에 실제로 적용된 세마포어 값 확인하기: Check the semaphore values actually applied to the current kernel
<code>kernel.sem = 250 32000 100 128</co: It is kernel.sem = 250 32000 100 128. The file holds "the values to use at boot and when the apply command runs", and sysctl NAME shows "the value the kernel is using right now". If you only edit the file without applying it, the two can differ, so check both. The RPM wrote the file and then ran sysctl --system, so it is already applied.
공유 메모리 최대 크기가 기준을 넘는지 계산하기: Calculate whether the maximum shared memory size exceeds the guideline
설치 가이드의 <code>kernel.shmmax</code> 최소값은: The installation guide's minimum for kernel.shmmax is half of physical memory (in bytes). RAM 32622588 kB × 1024 = 33,405,530,112 bytes, and half is 16,702,765,056 bytes. The RPM value 4,398,046,511,104 (4TB) is far larger, so it meets the guideline. kernel.shmall is in pages (4096 bytes), so 1,073,741,824 × 4096 = 4,398,046,511,104 bytes, the same size as shmmax.
접속에 쓰는 임시 포트 범위 찾기: Find the range of ephemeral ports used for connections
<code>9000 65535</code>입니다. 설치 가이드의 최소값: It is 9000 65535. The installation guide's minimum table says 9000 to 65500, but the configuration file of RPM 1.0-4.el8 writes 9000 to 65535 and leaves the 65500 line as a comment. Only the upper end is wider; the rule that it starts at 9000 is the same. When a document and a tool differ slightly like this, recording both is the accurate thing to do.
설정 파일 전체를 다시 적용하는 명령 실행해 보기: Run the command that reapplies all configuration files
<code>* Applying /etc/sysctl.d/... ...</: For each file you see the values applied, along with * Applying /etc/sysctl.d/... ... lines. The installation guide says that after changing kernel parameters you apply them with /sbin/sysctl --system and check them with /sbin/sysctl -a. Files are read in name order, so if the same key is in several files, the value read last wins.
커널 파라미터는 <b>파일(영구) → 적용(sysctl --system): Kernel parameters are handled in three steps: file (permanent) → apply (sysctl --system) → check (sysctl NAME). If shared memory or semaphores are insufficient, the instance may not start, so this is an item almost always on a handover checklist.
oracle 계정이 동시에 열 수 있는 파일 수, 만들 수 있는 프로세스: Check limits such as how many files the oracle account can open at once and how many processes it can create. If these values are small, problems appear as the DB grows: it cannot open more files or cannot create processes.
preinstall RPM이 만든 자원 제한 파일 읽기: Read the resource limits file created by the preinstall RPM
한 줄은 <code>사용자 종류 항목 값</code> 순서입니다. sof: Each line is in the order user type item value. soft is the value normally applied, and hard is the maximum a user can raise it to. The installation guide's rule is open files (nofile) soft at least 1024 and hard at least 65536, processes (nproc) soft at least 2047 and hard at least 16384, and stack soft at least 10240KB and hard 10240 to 32768KB. When using HugePages, memlock must be at least 90% of current RAM.
다른 자원 제한 파일도 있는지 보기: See whether there are other resource limits files
<code>20-nproc.conf</code>에는 <code>* sof: 20-nproc.conf has * soft nproc 4096 (all users). According to the limits.conf manual, a line naming a user takes precedence over group or * lines, so oracle gets 16384 from the RPM file. Also, * lines do not apply to root.
oracle 사용자로 로그인하기: Log in as the oracle user
자원 제한은 로그인할 때 PAM이 정합니다. root 셸에서 <code>: Resource limits are set by PAM at login. Typing ulimit in a root shell only shows root's limits, so to see oracle's values you must log in as oracle. su from root does not ask for a password.
열린 파일 수 한도의 soft와 hard 확인하기: Check the soft and hard limits on open files
<code>1024</code>와 <code>65536</code>입니다: They are 1024 and 65536. The commands the installation guide gives for checking are exactly ulimit -Sn and ulimit -Hn. Capital S is soft, H is hard, and n is open files.
프로세스 수와 스택 크기 한도 확인하기: Check the limits on processes and stack size
프로세스 수(u)는 16384/16384, 스택(s)은 10240/327: Processes (u) are 16384/16384 and stack (s) is 10240/32768KB. All are within the installation guide's rule. You can chain several commands on one line with ;.
자원 제한 파일을 고쳐도 <b>이미 로그인해 있는 셸에는 바뀌지 않습니다: Even if you edit the resource limits file, it does not change shells that are already logged in. The installation guide also says to log in again and check after changing the values. You experience this yourself in the graduation mission.
열린 파일 수가 모자라거나, 세션이 늘 때 프로세스를 만들지 못하는 문제: Running short of open files, or being unable to create processes as sessions grow, often starts with these limits. For a running DB, you can also see the limits a process actually received with cat /proc/PID/limits (not in this lab terminal).
이 서버에 만들 DB는 SGA를 8GB(SGA_TARGET=8G)로 잡을: The DB we will create on this server is planned with an 8GB SGA (SGA_TARGET=8G). A large SGA is best placed on HugePages, so calculate the number of pages needed and set it. Also check Transparent HugePages (THP).
지금 HugePages 상태와 페이지 크기 확인하기: Check the current HugePages status and page size
<code>HugePages_Total: 0</code>, <code>H: It shows HugePages_Total: 0 and Hugepagesize: 2048 kB. According to the Administrator's Reference, HugePages reduce page table overhead and are locked in memory, never swapped. The number needed is SGA ÷ huge page size (rounded up). 8GB = 8192MB, 8192 ÷ 2 = 4096 pages (documentation example: 1.6GB ÷ 2MB → 820).
4096페이지를 커널 파라미터 파일에 적기: Write 4096 pages into a kernel parameter file
echo 'vm.nr_hugepages = 4096' > /etc/sys:
echo 'vm.nr_hugepages = 4096' > /etc/sysctl.d/97-oracle-database-sysctl.conf
(or write the same line with vi and save)
설치 가이드가 손으로 커널 파라미터를 넣을 때 예로 드는 파일 이름이 <: The file name the installation guide uses as an example when adding kernel parameters by hand is /etc/sysctl.d/97-oracle-database-sysctl.conf. It must be written in a file to survive a reboot. sysctl -w changes only the current kernel.
출력에 <code>vm.nr_hugepages = 4096</code>이: If you see vm.nr_hugepages = 4096 in the output, it is applied.
HugePages가 잡혔는지 다시 확인하기: Check again that HugePages are reserved
<code>HugePages_Total: 4096</code>, <cod: It shows HugePages_Total: 4096 and HugePages_Free: 4096. 4096 × 2048kB = 8,388,608kB (8GB) was taken out of regular memory and went to HugePages. There is no DB yet, so all of it is Free; once the instance starts, the SGA uses it. Two points to watch. First, the Administrator's Reference says "AMM (Automatic Memory Management) and HugePages cannot be used together", so the DB uses SGA_TARGET instead of MEMORY_TARGET. Second, with HugePages memlock must be at least 90% of RAM, and the RPM value 134217728KB (128GB) is larger than 32622588 × 0.9 ≈ 29,360,329KB. Recalculating swap, 31.1GB − 8GB ≈ 23.1GB is still over 16GB, so the 16GB rule stays the same.
<code>always madvise [never]</code>에서 대괄: In always madvise [never], the bracketed one is the current value. The preinstall RPM changed it to never. THP has a name similar to HugePages above, but it is a different feature in which the kernel uses large pages on its own, and the documentation explains that it can cause memory allocation delays at run time. The installation guide's instructions for UEK kernels depend on the kernel version: disable it (never) on UEK earlier than UEK 7, and leave it at madvise on UEK 7 and later. The appendix of the Administrator's Reference says to disable THP before installation, so with RHCK 4.18 as on this server, never matches both documents and the preinstall RPM value. That is why lesson 1 (server check) checked the kernel type first.
재부팅 뒤에도 남도록 부팅 옵션에 들어갔는지 확인하기: Check that it went into the boot options so it survives a reboot
<code>GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX</code> 끝에 <code: numa=off transparent_hugepage=never was added to the end of GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX. These are the boot options the preinstall RPM adds on x86_64. /proc/cmdline, which shows the options used for the current boot, does not have them yet. Boot options take effect from the next reboot, and the RPM changed the currently running value by writing directly to /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled.
HugePages 수는 SGA 크기를 바꿀 때마다 다시 계산합니다. 설정: Recalculate the number of HugePages whenever you change the SGA size. If the setting is smaller than the SGA, part of the SGA is placed on regular pages, and if the initialization parameter is set to USE_LARGE_PAGES=ONLY, the instance may not start at all, as the Administrator's Reference explains. You will meet this again in the incident response stage.
디스크 I/O 스케줄러와 시계 확인하기: Checking the disk I/O scheduler and the clock
오라클 프로그램을 둘 /u01은 sdb, 데이터 파일을 둘 /u02는 n: /u01 for the Oracle software is on sdb, and /u02 for data files is on nvme0n1. Check whether each disk uses the I/O scheduler suited to its type, and how the virtual server's clock is set.
디스크와 파일 시스템 구성 보기: View the disk and file system layout
<code>sdb → vg_u01-lv_u01 → /u01</code>,: It shows as a tree which file system sits on which disk, as in sdb → vg_u01-lv_u01 → /u01 and nvme0n1 → nvme0n1p1 → /u02.
회전하는 디스크(HDD)인지 SSD인지 확인하기: Check whether each disk is a rotating disk (HDD) or an SSD
<code>ROTA</code>가 1이면 회전 디스크, 0이면 SSD나: ROTA 1 means a rotating disk, and 0 means a non-rotating device such as an SSD or NVMe. On this server sda and sdb are 1 and nvme0n1 is 0.
sdb의 I/O 스케줄러 확인하기: Check the I/O scheduler of sdb
<code>none [mq-deadline] kyber bfq</code: In none [mq-deadline] kyber bfq, the bracketed one is the scheduler in use. On Oracle Linux 8 and later, the installation guide recommends mq-deadline for rotating disks (HDD) and none for non-rotating devices such as SSD and NVMe. sdb meets the guideline. The example output in the documentation looks the same.
nvme0n1의 I/O 스케줄러 확인하기: Check the I/O scheduler of nvme0n1
<code>[none] mq-deadline kyber bfq</code: With [none] mq-deadline kyber bfq, none is selected, which meets the guideline for non-rotating devices. The same document adds that the scheduler for ASM disks should be discussed with the storage vendor.
가상 서버의 클럭 소스 확인하기: Check the clock source of the virtual server
지금은 <code>kvm-clock</code>이고, 쓸 수 있는 것은: It is currently kvm-clock, and the available ones are kvm-clock tsc acpi_pm. The installation guide recommends setting the clock source to tsc on Linux x86-64 virtual machines, and describes making it permanent by adding clocksource=tsc to the boot options. It requires a boot setting change and a reboot, so do not change it right away; note it in the check results and schedule it with the system administrator.
I/O 스케줄러와 클럭 소스는 \"바꾸는 명령\"보다 \"지금 값을 읽는: For the I/O scheduler and the clock source, "how to read the current value" comes before "the command to change it". Files under /sys are windows onto the kernel's current state, and reading them with cat tells you the current value with brackets or numbers.
직무 분리 그룹과 grid 사용자 만들기: Creating role-separation groups and the grid user
나중에 ASM(오라클의 디스크 관리 기능)을 쓸 계획이라, 설치 가이드: We plan to use ASM (Oracle's disk management feature) later, so create the ASM groups and the grid user in advance, as in the installation guide's example. The preinstall RPM creates only the oracle user and its groups. Finally, set passwords for both accounts.
지금 있는 오라클 그룹과 번호 확인하기: Check the existing Oracle groups and their numbers
oinstall 54321부터 racdba 54330까지 있고, 5432: They run from oinstall 54321 to racdba 54330, and 54327 to 54329 are empty. The installation guide's group example is oinstall 54321, dba 54322, oper 54323, backupdba 54324, dgdba 54325, kmdba 54326, asmdba 54327, asmoper 54328, asmadmin 54329, racdba 54330. The groups map to DB administrative privileges: dba is SYSDBA, oper is SYSOPER, backupdba is SYSBACKUP, dgdba is SYSDG, kmdba is SYSKM, and racdba is SYSRAC. They are used to divide work, for example separating the backup operator from the DBA.
<code>-g</code>로 그룹 번호를 정합니다. 번호를 정하지 않으: -g sets the group number. If you do not set one, the system assigns any number. Group names and numbers must match across servers (especially in a cluster), so create them with fixed numbers as in the installation guide.
asmoper(54328)와 asmadmin(54329) 그룹도 만들기: Also create the asmoper (54328) and asmadmin (54329) groups
asmadmin은 ASM을 관리하는 OSASM 그룹(SYSASM 권한)입: asmadmin is the OSASM group that administers ASM (SYSASM privilege). asmdba is the DB-side group that accesses ASM, and asmoper is the operator group for ASM.
설치 가이드 예시대로 grid 사용자 만들기: Create the grid user as in the installation guide's example
설치 가이드의 명령 그대로입니다. <code>-u</code>는 사용자: This is the installation guide's command exactly. -u is the user number, -g the primary group, and -G the secondary groups. The server configuration checklist says "the OINSTALL group must be the primary group of all Oracle installation owners on the server". That is why grid's primary group is also oinstall.
oracle 사용자를 asmdba 그룹에 넣기: Add the oracle user to the asmdba group
설치 가이드의 usermod 예시입니다. <code>-G</code>는: This is the installation guide's usermod example. -G replaces the whole list of secondary groups, so you must list all the groups it already had too. Any you leave out are removed (to only add to the existing list, use -a -G). The same document warns, "do not change the primary group of an Oracle software owner already in use; the central inventory may be corrupted". Here the primary group stays oinstall as before.
두 사용자의 번호와 그룹 확인하기: Check the numbers and groups of both users
<code>uid=54331(grid) gid=54321(oinstall: It shows something like uid=54331(grid) gid=54321(oinstall) groups=54321(oinstall),54329(asmadmin),54327(asmdba),54330(racdba). It is the numbers, not the human-readable names, that decide file ownership, so compare numbers when aligning several servers.
passwd oracle\n(실습용 oracle123 을 두 번 입력,:
passwd oracle
(type the lab password oracle123 twice; it is not shown on screen)
<code>passwd: all authentication tokens: You are done when passwd: all authentication tokens updated successfully. appears. root can change other users' passwords, and ordinary users can change only their own.
grid 계정 비밀번호도 정하기: Set the grid account's password too
passwd grid\n(실습용 grid123 을 두 번 입력):
passwd grid
(type the lab password grid123 twice)
이제 두 계정으로 로그인할 수 있습니다. 실제 운영에서는 회사의 비밀번호: Now you can log in with both accounts. In real operations, follow the company's password rules and never write passwords in documents or scripts.
이 실습은 설치 가이드의 그룹 예시를 그대로 따랐지만, 문서는 그룹 이름: This lab followed the installation guide's group example exactly, but the documentation notes that you may rename the groups and recommends separate groups for each privilege. What matters is not the names but two things: the same numbers on every server and oinstall as the primary group of every installation owner.
설치 디렉터리 만들기와 경로 규칙: Creating installation directories and path conventions
이제 오라클을 설치할 디렉터리를 만들 차례예요. 시스템 관리자가 남긴 메: Now it is time to create the directories to install Oracle in. First read the memo the system administrator left (/root/memo_from_sysadmin.txt), check it against the installation guide's rules, and then create them.
/data/app/oracle에 설치하라고 되어 있습니다. 그런데 /da: It says to install in /data/app/oracle. But it says /data is not an original directory but "a name I created". Let's check.
<code>lrwxrwxrwx. ... /data -&gt; /u01</: lrwxrwxrwx. ... /data -> /u01 starts with l, so it is a symbolic link. The installation guide says "the Oracle home or Oracle base cannot be a symbolic link, and none of its parent directories up to the root can be symbolic links either". /data/app/oracle breaks this rule, so use the real path /u01/app/oracle. Tell the administrator why you did not follow the memo.
Oracle base와 oraInventory 디렉터리 만들기: Create the Oracle base and oraInventory directories
<code>-p</code>는 중간 디렉터리(/u01/app)까지 한 번: -p creates the intermediate directory (/u01/app) at the same time. This is the installation guide's command exactly. According to the server configuration checklist, oraInventory (the central inventory) goes one level above the Oracle base. So it is created alongside it under /u01/app, not inside /u01/app/oracle.
두 디렉터리의 소유자를 oracle:oinstall로 바꾸기: Change the owner of both directories to oracle:oinstall
root로 만든 디렉터리는 root 소유라서 oracle이 그 안에 쓸: Directories created as root are owned by root, so oracle cannot write in them. -R changes everything inside as well, files and directories.
775는 소유자와 그룹은 읽기·쓰기·들어가기가 되고, 그 밖의 사용자는: 775 lets the owner and the group read, write, and enter, and lets other users only read and enter. This is because other installation owners in the oinstall group (grid) must also be able to write to the inventory. The checklist also says that the OINSTALL group must be writable by all Oracle installation owners.
You are done when you see drwxrwxr-x. ... oracle oinstall ... oracle and ... oraInventory. /u01/app itself stays owned by root, but at 775 the oinstall group can write to it.
이 서버에 오라클이 설치된 적이 있는지 oraInst.loc로 확인하기: Check with oraInst.loc whether Oracle has ever been installed on this server
<code>No such file or directory</code>입니: It says No such file or directory. /etc/oraInst.loc is the file that records the central inventory location (inventory_loc) and the inventory group (inst_group), so if it is missing, this is the first Oracle installation on the server. orainstRoot.sh, run as root at the end of the first installation, creates this file. On the stage 1 server it contained inventory_loc=/u01/app/oraInventory and inst_group=oinstall.
oracle로 바꿔 Oracle home 디렉터리 만들기: Switch to oracle and create the Oracle home directory
설치 가이드는 Oracle home을 <b>oracle 사용자로</b>: The installation guide says to create the Oracle home as the oracle user, extract the installation image into it with unzip -q, and install with ./runInstaller in that directory. It also cautions against using a runInstaller from another location. If you had not fixed the owner and permissions earlier, you would get Permission denied here.
oracle의 umask와 ORACLE_HOME 변수 확인하기: Check oracle's umask and the ORACLE_HOME variable
umask는 <code>0022</code>, ORACLE_HOME은 비: umask is 0022 and ORACLE_HOME is empty. The installation guide says to set the installation user's umask to 022 and, before installation, not to put Oracle environment variables such as ORACLE_HOME in the startup file (stage 1 lesson 8 was set on a server where installation was already finished).
OFA 규칙으로 정리하면 Oracle base는 <code>/u01/ap: Summed up with the OFA rules: the Oracle base is /u01/app/oracle, the Oracle home is /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0/dbhome_1, and the inventory is /u01/app/oraInventory. The OFA example puts data files on another disk, as in /u02/app/oracle/oradata, and the installation guide requires at least 1.5GB for the data file directory and at least 2GB for the recovery area. Use only ASCII characters in paths, user names, and group names.
졸업 미션: 남이 준비한 서버 점검하고 고치기: Graduation mission: check and fix a server someone else prepared
이대리가 preinstall RPM 없이 손으로 준비한 dbserver0: This is dbserver03, which Lee prepared by hand without the preinstall RPM. Read the handover memo (/root/handover_dbserver03.txt), check it against what you learned in stage 2, and fix what is wrong. There are probably about five problems. Leave the results in /root/precheck_report.txt.
필수 패키지를 확인하고 빠진 것 설치하기: Check the required packages and install what is missing
ksh가 빠져 있었습니다. 패키지는 설치 가이드의 Oracle Linux: ksh was missing. Compare packages with the installation guide's Oracle Linux 8 table.
세마포어 값을 점검하고 최소값 이상으로 고쳐 적용하기: Check the semaphore values, fix them to at least the minimums, and apply
세 번째 값 semopm이 32로, 최소값 100보다 작았습니다. ker: The third value, semopm, was 32, below the minimum of 100. kernel.sem must list all four values in order, so a single wrong number is easy to miss. After fixing the file, apply it with sysctl --system and check again with sysctl kernel.sem.
oracle의 주 그룹을 확인하고 oinstall로 바로잡기: Check oracle's primary group and correct it to oinstall
<code>gid=54322(dba)</code>로 주 그룹이 dba였습: With gid=54322(dba), the primary group was dba. The checklist says OINSTALL must be the primary group of every installation owner. The installation guide warns that changing the primary group of an owner already in use can corrupt the central inventory, but nothing has been installed on this server yet (no oraInst.loc), so it must be corrected now. Found after installation, it would be a much bigger problem.
열린 파일 수 hard 한도를 기준 이상으로 고치기: Fix the hard limit on open files to meet the guideline
hard nofile이 4096으로, 설치 가이드 기준 65536보다 작: hard nofile was 4096, below the installation guide's 65536.
oracle로 다시 로그인해서 고친 값이 적용됐는지 확인하기: Log in again as oracle and check that the fixed value is applied
<code>65536</code>이 나옵니다. 파일을 고치기 전에 이미: It shows 65536. If a window was already logged in as oracle before you fixed the file, that window still shows 4096. That is why the order is "fix, then log in again and check".
설치 디렉터리의 소유자와 권한 바로잡기: Correct the owner and permissions of the installation directories
/u01/app 아래가 root:root, 755였습니다. 이대로면 or: Under /u01/app everything was root:root, 755. Left like this, oracle gets Permission denied when creating the Oracle home.
vi /root/precheck_report.txt\n(또는 echo \:
vi /root/precheck_report.txt
(or echo "installed ksh, kernel.sem semopm 32→100, oracle primary group dba→oinstall, nofile hard 4096→65536, /u01/app owner root→oracle:oinstall, 775" > /root/precheck_report.txt)
무엇을, 어떤 기준으로, 무엇에서 무엇으로 바꿨는지 적어 두면 다음 사람: If you write down what you changed, by which criterion, and from what to what, the next person can check it again exactly.
수고했습니다. 2단계를 마쳤습니다. 현장에서는 이런 점검을 도구로도 합니: Well done. You have finished stage 2. In the field, these checks are also done with tools. The installation guide's Installer Planning Checklist says to run ORAchk with ./orachk -profile preinstall before installation, and when the installer finds fixable items in its pre-checks it creates a fixup script (runfixup.sh) to run as root. However, the installation guide notes that it does not guarantee the fixup script meets every requirement. Only when you know the criteria and can check them yourself, as today, can you read the tools' results properly. (This lab terminal does not imitate ORAchk or the installer.)
